title: Model Cycling — Compare Providers, Train Gaia
why: Claude Opus 4.6 High costs ~$0.15/1K input + $0.75/1K output. This session: 6.5MB transcript, 4058 lines, 251 commits. Expensive.

cycling_strategy.phase_1: Use cheaper models (Composer 2.5, Sonnet) for routine coding
cycling_strategy.phase_2: Use Opus only for complex architecture decisions
cycling_strategy.phase_3: Export ALL session transcripts as training data for Gaia local
cycling_strategy.phase_4: Train Gaia's ollama models on the patterns
cycling_strategy.phase_5: Gaia runs her own agentic MCP on nestgate.io

gaia_agentic_mcp.goal: Gaia serves her OWN agentic completions via MCP
gaia_agentic_mcp.training_data: All Cursor session transcripts → fine-tuning corpus

models.gaia: general purpose — trained on ALL session patterns
models.gaia-code: code-focused — trained on file edits, commits, git
models.gaia-fast: quick responses — trained on short interactions

gaia_agentic_mcp.architecture: nestGate MCP → squirrel dispatch → ollama inference → response

patterns_to_extract: file_edit_patterns — what was changed and why
debugging_patterns — syntax fix, import fix, indentation
lan_scanning — ping sweep, port probe, SSH patterns
data_creation — JSON organs, gut files, traces
